title: SALNÖ bench
description: SALNÖ bench, rattan Easy to bring home, simple to assemble – and unique. With its soft and curved shapes in handwoven rattan, the stable SALNÖ bench helps you welcome a piece of nature into your home. Sturdy bench made of handwoven rattan that adds a unique touch of nature to your home.
features: Rattan is a natural fiber that might change color over time.
Tighten all hardware/screws securely before use. Check them regularly and retighten if necessary.
May be completed with GRYTTOM cushion set to sit even more comfortably.
Follow the assembly instructions in the package.
